> **Not yet implemented.** In the current build this command prints
> `fmt: not implemented yet` and exits with code 2.

## Usage

```text
provenance fmt [path...] [flags]
```

Reformat entity files (default: every entity in the repository) to canonical serialization: stable frontmatter key order, one field per line, stable list-row and block layout. Clean git merges depend on every file being in this form.

`--check` verifies without writing; it runs at the merge gate alongside validate.

## Flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--check` | — | report files that are not canonical instead of rewriting them |
